messages:
maria: Heads-up — Nimbus Cloud + TensorEdge confirmed the joint webinar for May 10. Need to lock speakers, demo flow, and swag cutoffs this week.

josh: Awesome. Who are the primary contacts on their side?

maria: Nimbus: @sophie-nimbus (PM), TensorEdge: @raj-tensor (partner eng). I pinged both and asked for speaker names.

erica: Can we do 45m total? 20m demo, 15m panel, 10m Q&A. That gives time for setup and audience questions.

josh: +1 on 45m. For the demo, we should show live inference on Redwood Dedicated and a failover to hosted. Raj OK with that?

maria: Raj said live run on TensorEdge hardware is fine but wants a dry run on 5/3.

vijay: I'll own the dry run. Can we schedule 30m for it: infra checks + model warmup + slide sync.

lisa: I'll own slides and deck template. Partners will add logos and 2 slides each for product highlights. Deadline for final deck: 5/6 COB.

carter: Swag question — TensorEdge wants exclusive stickers, Nimbus wants co-branded shirts. Swag-coordinator-bot: we have 120 sticker kits and 60 shirts available in our EU warehouse. Shipping ETA to venue: 5/8 if shipped today.

maria: Shipping timeline is tight. Can we do booth pickup at venue instead of shipping? saves customs headaches.

swag-coordinator-bot: Note: booth pickup requires partner reps to bring proof of identity and PO. For shirts, we need sizes by 5/2.

josh: Action items: 1) Confirm speakers (partners + maria + me). 2) Dry run 5/3 (vijay). 3) Final deck 5/6 (lisa). 4) Swag sizes by 5/2 (partners). 5) AV checklist + stream link (erica).

erica: AV checklist draft:
```
- Confirm HDMI + USB-C adapters
- Test audio (headset + room mic)
- Stream key and RTMP test
- Backup laptop with local recording
- Wired ethernet for presenter
```

maria: Also need the Eventbrite link for promotion and the co-marketing copy. Marketing wants a 50-word blurb by 5/4.

josh: I'll loop in @sylvia-marketing after this thread.

raj-tensor (via DM confirmed with maria): We'll send speaker bios and demo model checkpoint by 5/1. Raj asked about model size — prefer <20B for tensor hardware demo.

lisa: Noted. We'll size the slides for a 15-20 token/sec clip and include fallback screenshots.

vijay: For the dry run, please include a script like:
```
1) Warm model (30s)
2) Run 2 demo prompts (1-2m each)
3) Force failover to hosted (simulate hardware disconnect)
4) Show latency/cost dashboard
```

carter: Swag follow-up: partners confirmed co-branded sticker set. TensorEdge to ship shirts to our SF office by 5/2 for consolidation. If customs blocks, we'll fallback to gift cards.

maria: Logistics note — if shirts arrive late, we can do a digital swag drop (promo code) and put physical fulfillment as follow-up. Not ideal but ok.

erica: Who's the MC? We need someone to introduce speakers and moderate Q&A. Josh?

josh: I can MC if needed. Prefer to keep technical moderation to raj or one of our senior engs.

lisa: Can we get a slide with 3 live demo prompts and put them in the chat during the webinar? helps engagement.

vijay: Good idea. I'll create a small prompt deck and hand it to lisa.

sophie-nimbus (via email to maria): Nimbus will supply a short customer case slide and a quote. They want logo placement left.

maria: Perfect. Final check: recording permission in Eventbrite + slide release waiver from partners. I'll send a simple one-pager.

josh: I'll summarize and send a Trello with tasks after this. Thanks all — next sync if any blockers by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:
